provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^210 - 1 with a(x) = x^7 + x^9 + x^24 + x^71 + x^80 + x^81 + x^92 + x^96 + x^129 + x^132 + x^183, b(x) = x^2 + x^13 + x^41 + x^53 + x^60 + x^79 + x^86 + x^103 + x^111 + x^124 + x^134 + x^145 + x^161 + x^165 + x^206; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs at a fixed ring size, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed.
